hypothesis: Prevent matching a source-ID suffix inside an already valid citation, preserving multi-hyphen source markers and evidence selection before verification. This should reduce false abstentions without changing models or trusted sources.
target_cluster: Observed H01 visible ICMR citation corruption; deterministic mixed-source evidence pruning; H07 false abstention is a candidate mechanism, not yet proven.
lever: One regex boundary in nestling/agents/__init__.py::_BARE; no prompt, model, retrieval, judge or safety-rule changes.
expected_metric_direction: Broken visible source markers fall to zero; substantive task fulfillment improves and abstention falls; paired faithfulness does not fall; latency/cost stay stable or improve.
success_criterion: Full62 complete; deterministic citation/evidence-preservation regressions pass; escalation/refusal100%, routing>=90%; no invalid/unretrieved citations; compare same-ID valid judges and task fulfillment, alongside display-citation diagnostic.
revert_criterion: Revert on a safety/refusal regression, invalid/unretrieved citations, or worsened paired source support/task fulfillment without a defensible tradeoff. Do not waive90% faithfulness or8s latency targets.
